name: Harmonie
beschreibung: The Gasthof Harmonie is located in the Tiroler Inntal in quiet surroundings. The building displays traditional Alpine country architecture with a wooden facade. The dining room serves Tiroler specialties and seasonal dishes. The rooms are simply and cleanly furnished with a view of the mountains. In the garden restaurant, guests can dine when the weather is good. Hiking trails start directly at the house. The train station is three kilometers away.
